component.name: Ducktor
component.summary: Offline translator for text and voice

description.p: Ducktor translates text and speech on your own computer with local AI models. You can write, paste or dictate, and listen to the translation.

ul.li: No account, telemetry or history: your text and recordings never leave your computer.
It only connects to the internet when you download a model.
Interface in English, Spanish, French, Italian and German.
